name: 微信输入法
description:
微信输入法，简洁好用无广告，优点是比搜狗输入法更纯洁，缺点是要绑定微信才能发挥除打字外的其他附加功能 (如剪切板同步，传图等)
主要针对机房，白板无物理键盘可能不适用
descriptionEn: WeChat Input Method is clean, easy to use and ad-free. It is cleaner than Sogou, but some extra features (clipboard sync, image transfer) require linking WeChat. Primarily for computer labs; whiteboards without a physical keyboard may not benefit.
author: 腾讯
